3. **Component** - Decomposes containers into components
4. **Code** - Optional level showing code-level details (classes, interfaces)

Here's a sample C4 diagram set for a client-server app, using Mermaid syntax (renders on GitHub, GitLab, and most Markdown tools).

## Level 1 — System Context

```mermaid
C4Context
    title System Context - Online Store

    Person(customer, "Customer", "Browses products and places orders")
    Person(admin, "Admin", "Manages inventory and orders")

    System(store, "Online Store", "Allows customers to browse and purchase products")

    System_Ext(payment, "Payment Gateway", "Processes credit card transactions")
    System_Ext(email, "Email Service", "Sends order confirmations and notifications")

    Rel(customer, store, "Browses, searches, orders")
    Rel(admin, store, "Manages products and orders")
    Rel(store, payment, "Processes payments", "HTTPS/JSON")
    Rel(store, email, "Sends notifications", "SMTP")
```

## Level 2 — Container

```mermaid
C4Container
    title Container Diagram - Online Store

    Person(customer, "Customer", "Browses products and places orders")

    System_Boundary(store, "Online Store") {
        Container(spa, "Web App", "React", "Single-page application served to the browser")
        Container(api, "API Server", "Node.js / Express", "Handles business logic, serves JSON API")
        ContainerDb(db, "Database", "PostgreSQL", "Stores products, orders, users")
        Container(cache, "Cache", "Redis", "Session store and query cache")
    }

    System_Ext(payment, "Payment Gateway", "Processes credit card transactions")
    System_Ext(email, "Email Service", "Sends notifications")

    Rel(customer, spa, "Uses", "HTTPS")
    Rel(spa, api, "Calls", "HTTPS/JSON")
    Rel(api, db, "Reads/writes", "TCP/5432")
    Rel(api, cache, "Reads/writes", "TCP/6379")
    Rel(api, payment, "Processes payments", "HTTPS/JSON")
    Rel(api, email, "Sends emails", "SMTP")
```

## Level 3 — Component

```mermaid
C4Component
    title Component Diagram - API Server

    Container_Boundary(api, "API Server") {
        Component(auth, "Auth Controller", "Express Router", "Handles login, registration, JWT tokens")
        Component(products, "Product Controller", "Express Router", "Product CRUD and search")
        Component(orders, "Order Controller", "Express Router", "Order placement and tracking")
        Component(paymentSvc, "Payment Service", "Module", "Integrates with external payment gateway")
        Component(repo, "Data Access Layer", "Module", "ORM queries and data mapping")
    }

    ContainerDb(db, "Database", "PostgreSQL")
    System_Ext(payment, "Payment Gateway")

    Rel(auth, repo, "Uses")
    Rel(products, repo, "Uses")
    Rel(orders, repo, "Uses")
    Rel(orders, paymentSvc, "Delegates payment")
    Rel(paymentSvc, payment, "Calls", "HTTPS")
    Rel(repo, db, "Reads/writes", "SQL")
```
